name: agent-data-studio
description: Turn an AI agent into a data analyst that works directly in the tools. 9 skills in one chain — data-discovery, data-mockup, pbi-model, pbi-analysis, pbi-design, pbi-build, pbi-review, pbi-publish, pbi-knowledge — plus 8 /pbi-* commands and 2 agents. Microsoft skills-for-fabric references (MIT) ship verbatim inside the skills; data-safety policy keeps raw rows out of context. Engine (CLI + MCP) installs separately into $ADS_DATA. Built by KPIM (kpim.vn), shared free.
